source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    zero_rows = {r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 0 in row}
    zero_cols = {c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[c] == 0 for row in grid)}
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if (r in zero_rows or c in zero_cols) and grid[r][c] != 2:
                out[r][c] = 0
    return out
'''
